title: Peter denied Jesus.
paragraphs:
Three times.
In public.
In fear.
The same man who said, “Even if everyone else falls away, I never will.”
God used Peter to preach a sermon that led thousands to salvation.
“Repent and be baptized… for the forgiveness of your sins. And you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.”
About 3,000 people were added that day.

The man who once denied Jesus
was now proclaiming Jesus boldly.
Your worst moment does not cancel God's calling.
Failure is not the end of your story.

When repentance meets grace,
God writes redemption.
Peter’s denial became a testimony of mercy.

And the same God who restored Peter
is still restoring people today.
If you’ve failed, fallen, or drifted…
Grace is stronger than your past.
🔥 Comment RESTORE if you believe God can redeem your story.
